canon: Planeadora grande de alas rígidas que cabalga los frentes de viento. Vuela alto y en círculos con buen tiempo; cuando cruza baja y en línea recta, los pastores saben que viene tormenta de arena magnética. Anida en lo alto de los Pilares Rotos. Cazarla es dificilísimo salvo en nido o con trampa cebada.

prompt.sujeto: A huge, heavy-bodied bird of prey in full flight, with a thick, deep chest, a short body and two very long, broad wings raised and swept up and outward.
prompt.proporcion: The wingspan is about three and a half times the length of its torso, each wing is one and a half times as wide as the body is deep, and the head is two thirds as long as the torso.
prompt.cuerpo: The belly and thighs are dark umber-brown, covered in small, overlapping, leathery scales. The long flight feathers of both wings are glossy black, the lower ones edged in deep red.
rasgos: The head and shoulders are armoured with thick, ridged, jagged plates of dull bone-grey and pale cream that grow out of the dark skin, and a crown of long, sharp, backswept bone-grey spikes rises from the back of the head.
The beak is long, pale grey and deeply hooked, and a small amber eye glints under a heavy bony brow.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: The thick, scaly legs hang forward below the belly, ending in long, black, curved talons.
prompt.pose: Seen in three-quarter view, the body is tilted in a shallow dive with the wings raised in a V and the head angled downward, turned slightly toward the viewer, the whole bird visible from wing tip to wing tip.
prompt.entorno: Below it a vast red-brown dust storm sweeps across the plain and rolls up the left side of the frame with flying grit, and tall, jagged, pale-brown rock pillars crowd the right horizon.
prompt.luz: The low sun breaks through a heavy bank of dark storm clouds at the upper right, sending golden rays across a copper-orange sky and lighting the bone plates and the feather edges with warm light.

rasgos+: This male has a taller crown of spikes and heavier plates over the shoulders.
This female is slightly larger in the wings, with a lower crown of spikes and smaller plates over the shoulders.

momento:noche.luz: Deep blue night with stars showing through gaps in a heavy bank of dark storm clouds at the upper right under a soft, even pearly glow, and a cool silver-blue light picks out the bone plates and the red feather edges.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore

choca con el canon: placas óseas en cabeza y hombros con cresta de púas, escamas de cuero en vientre y muslos, plumas de vuelo negras con borde rojo, picos y garras de ave de presa acorazada (el canon: planeadora de alas rígidas, sin armadura descrita); envergadura de unos tres torsos y medio

capas.corto: A single huge bird of prey, in full flight and three-quarter view from slightly below, diving left to right across the centre of the frame. Warm low sun behind clouds on the upper right. It has the body of a condor, a head and shoulders armoured in pale bone plates with a crown of long spikes like a stegosaurus's, and a heavy hooked beak like an eagle's. Its two broad wings are held out wide, swept up and back, black above with red-edged flight feathers. Its legs are scaly with black talons. Behind it, a wall of orange dust cloud. Tall dark rock pillars on the right.
capas.sujeto: A single huge armoured bird of prey, seen in full flight from slightly below and three-quarters from the front, diving from left to right across the centre of the image, its wings filling the whole width of the frame.
capas.luz: Warm low sun breaking through heavy clouds on the upper right, with beams of light: the bone plates of the head and shoulders catch the light, the wings are dark and the underside of the body is in shadow; the dust wall on the left glows orange.
capas.tamano: Its wings are wider than the whole frame and each is about three times the length of its body; the rock pillars on the right are far larger than the bird in real size, but look smaller because they are far away.
capas.forma: The heavy chest and body of a condor. A head with a long, deeply hooked beak like an eagle's and a round amber eye, covered in pale bone plates with a crown of long, sharp backward-pointing spikes like the back of a stegosaurus. Overlapping bone plates like a pangolin's cover the shoulders. Two very broad wings with long fingered feathers at the tips. Scaly lizard-like thighs and legs, ending in long black curved talons held forward under the body. A short feathered tail.
capas.entorno: In the foreground and on the left, a steep slope of rolling orange-brown dust and loose stones, a storm wall of dust sweeping past. In the middle distance, a plain of dark broken rock. On the right horizon, a cluster of tall, dark, craggy rock pillars rising into the clouds, under a sky of heavy brown clouds with the sun breaking through.
capas.color: Pale bone-grey and dirty off-white armour plates, stained brown in their grooves; black feathers above the wings with dark red edges to the flight feathers; dark grey scaly legs and black talons; amber eye; orange-brown dust; dark brown pillars.
capas.paleta: dark brown, bone grey and burnt orange with one accent of deep red
capas.notas: IMG-55, escrita mirando el banner. Variante por defecto (macho en el banner: cresta de púas alta). Diferencias con el canon: placas óseas en cabeza y hombros con cresta de púas, patas escamosas de lagarto y garras negras, plumas de vuelo negras con borde rojo, pico de rapaz y no de planeadora; vuela bajo, en picado y no «alto y en círculos» (casa con 'cruza bajo', que el canon asocia a tormenta); alas curvadas hacia arriba, no rígidas y rectas; pilares rocosos (los Pilares Rotos) a la derecha; muro de polvo naranja a la izquierda. La plantilla anterior (cóndor pelado gris, pico gris) no casaba. Ver banner-vs-canon.md.
